verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֤י׀ אָג֥וּר בִּן־ יָקֶ֗ה הַמַּ֫שָּׂ֥א הַ֭גֶּבֶר נְאֻ֣ם לְאִֽיתִיאֵ֑ל לְאִ֖יתִיאֵ֣ל וְאֻכָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: diḇ·rê ’ā·ḡūr bin- yā·qeh ham·maś·śā hag·ge·ḇer nə·’um lə·’î·ṯî·’êl lə·’î·ṯî·’êl wə·’u·ḵāl
verses.literal: [These are] the words of Agur son of Jakeh the burden that this man declared to Ithiel I am weary, O God, and worn out

verses.original: כִּ֤י אָנֹכִ֣י בַ֣עַר מֵאִ֑ישׁ וְלֹֽא־ בִינַ֖ת אָדָ֣ם לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ā·nō·ḵî ḇa·‘ar mê·’îš wə·lō- ḇî·naṯ ’ā·ḏām lî
verses.literal: Surely I [am] the most ignorant of men and I lack the understanding of a man

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ לָמַ֥דְתִּי חָכְמָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת אֵדָֽע׃ קְדֹשִׁ֣ים
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- lā·maḏ·tî ḥāḵ·māh wə·ḏa·‘aṯ ’ê·ḏā‘ qə·ḏō·šîm
verses.literal: I have not learned wisdom and I have no knowledge . . . of the Holy One

verses.original: מִ֤י עָלָֽה־ שָׁמַ֨יִם׀ וַיֵּרַ֡ד מִ֤י אָֽסַף־ ר֨וּחַ׀ בְּחָפְנָ֡יו מִ֤י צָֽרַר־ מַ֨יִם׀ בַּשִּׂמְלָ֗ה מִ֭י הֵקִ֣ים כָּל־ אַפְסֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ מַה־ שְּׁמ֥וֹ וּמַֽה־ שֶּׁם־ בְּ֝נ֗וֹ כִּ֣י תֵדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: mî ‘ā·lāh- šā·ma·yim way·yê·raḏ mî ’ā·sap̄- rū·aḥ bə·ḥā·p̄ə·nāw mî ṣā·rar- ma·yim baś·śim·lāh mî hê·qîm kāl- ’ap̄·sê- ’ā·reṣ mah- šə·mōw ū·mah- šem- bə·nōw kî ṯê·ḏā‘
verses.literal: Who has ascended to heaven and come down Who has gathered the wind in His hands Who has bound up the waters in His cloak Who has established all the ends of the earth What is His name and what is the name of His Son surely you know

verses.original: כָּל־ אִמְרַ֣ת אֱל֣וֹהַּ צְרוּפָ֑ה ה֝֗וּא מָגֵ֥ן לַֽחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’im·raṯ ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ṣə·rū·p̄āh hū mā·ḡên la·ḥō·sîm bōw
verses.literal: Every word of God is flawless He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him

verses.original: אַל־ תּ֥וֹסְףְּ עַל־ דְּבָרָ֑יו פֶּן־ יוֹכִ֖יחַ בְּךָ֣ וְנִכְזָֽבְתָּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’al- tō·wsp ‘al- də·ḇā·rāw pen- yō·w·ḵî·aḥ bə·ḵā wə·niḵ·zā·ḇə·tā
verses.literal: Do not add to His words lest He rebuke you and prove you a liar

verses.original: שְׁ֭תַּיִם שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵאִתָּ֑ךְ מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי אַל־ תִּמְנַ֥ע בְּטֶ֣רֶם אָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ta·yim šā·’al·tî mê·’it·tāḵ mim·men·nî ’al- tim·na‘ bə·ṭe·rem ’ā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Two things I ask . . . of You do not refuse me before I die

verses.original: שָׁ֤וְא׀ כָּזָ֡ב וּֽדְבַר־ הַרְחֵ֬ק מִמֶּ֗נִּי תִּֽתֶּן־ לִ֑י אַל־ רֵ֣אשׁ וָ֭עֹשֶׁר הַ֝טְרִיפֵ֗נִי לֶ֣חֶם חֻקִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šāw kā·zāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇar- har·ḥêq mim·men·nî tit·ten- lî ’al- rêš wā·‘ō·šer haṭ·rî·p̄ê·nî le·ḥem ḥuq·qî
verses.literal: Keep falsehood and deceitful words far from me Give me neither poverty nor riches feed me with the bread that is my portion

verses.original: פֶּ֥ן אֶשְׂבַּ֨ע׀ וְכִחַשְׁתִּי֮ וְאָמַ֗רְתִּי מִ֥י יְה֫וָ֥ה וּפֶֽן־ אִוָּרֵ֥שׁ וְגָנַ֑בְתִּי וְ֝תָפַ֗שְׂתִּי שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: pen ’eś·ba‘ wə·ḵi·ḥaš·tî wə·’ā·mar·tî mî Yah·weh ū·p̄en- ’iw·wā·rêš wə·ḡā·naḇ·tî wə·ṯā·p̄aś·tî šêm ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: Otherwise I may have too much and deny You saying Who is the LORD Or I may become poor and steal profaning the name of my God

verses.original: אַל־ תַּלְשֵׁ֣ן עֶ֭בֶד אֶל־ אֲדֹנוֹ פֶּֽן־ יְקַלֶּלְךָ֥ וְאָשָֽׁמְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tal·šên ‘e·ḇeḏ ’el- ʾă·ḏō·nō pen- yə·qal·lel·ḵā wə·’ā·šā·mə·tā
verses.literal: Do not slander a servant to his master or he will curse you and you will bear the guilt

verses.original: דּ֭וֹר יְקַלֵּ֑ל וְאֶת־ אָבִ֣יו לֹ֣א יְבָרֵֽךְ׃ אִ֝מּ֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: dō·wr yə·qal·lêl wə·’eṯ- ’ā·ḇîw lō yə·ḇā·rêḵ ’im·mōw
verses.literal: There is a generation of those who curse - their fathers and do not bless their mothers

verses.original: דּ֭וֹר טָה֣וֹר בְּעֵינָ֑יו לֹ֣א רֻחָֽץ׃ וּ֝מִצֹּאָת֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: dō·wr ṭā·hō·wr bə·‘ê·nāw lō ru·ḥāṣ ū·miṣ·ṣō·’ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: There is a generation of those who are pure in their own eyes vvv and yet unwashed of their filth

verses.original: דּ֭וֹר מָה־ רָמ֣וּ עֵינָ֑יו יִנָּשֵֽׂאוּ׃ וְ֝עַפְעַפָּ֗יו
verses.transliteration: dō·wr māh- rā·mū ‘ê·nāw yin·nā·śê·’ū wə·‘ap̄·‘ap·pāw
verses.literal: There is a generation how haughty are their eyes and pretentious are their glances

verses.original: דּ֤וֹר׀ שִׁנָּיו֮ חֲרָב֣וֹת מְֽתַלְּעֹ֫תָ֥יו וּֽמַאֲכָל֪וֹת לֶאֱכֹ֣ל עֲנִיִּ֣ים מֵאֶ֑רֶץ וְ֝אֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים מֵאָדָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: dō·wr šin·nāw ḥă·rā·ḇō·wṯ mə·ṯal·lə·‘ō·ṯāw ū·ma·’ă·ḵā·lō·wṯ le·’ĕ·ḵōl ‘ă·nî·yîm mê·’e·reṣ wə·’eḇ·yō·w·nîm mê·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: there is a generation whose teeth are swords and whose jaws are knives devouring the oppressed from the earth and the needy from [among] men

verses.original: לַֽעֲלוּקָ֨ה׀ שְׁתֵּ֥י בָנוֹת֮ הַ֤ב׀ הַ֥ב הֵ֭נָּה שָׁל֣וֹשׁ לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּ֑עְנָה אַ֝רְבַּ֗ע לֹא־ אָ֥מְרוּ הֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: la·‘ă·lū·qāh šə·tê ḇā·nō·wṯ haḇ haḇ hên·nāh šā·lō·wōš lō ṯiś·ba‘·nāh ’ar·ba‘ lō- ’ā·mə·rū hō·wn
verses.literal: The leech has two daughters Give [and] Give There are three [things that] are never satisfied four [that] never say Enough

verses.original: שְׁאוֹל֮ וְעֹ֪צֶ֫ר רָ֥חַם אֶ֭רֶץ לֹא־ שָׂ֣בְעָה מַּ֑יִם וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ לֹא־ אָ֥מְרָה הֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: šə·’ō·wl wə·‘ō·ṣer rā·ḥam ’e·reṣ lō- śā·ḇə·‘āh ma·yim wə·’êš lō- ’ā·mə·rāh hō·wn
verses.literal: Sheol the barren womb land never satisfied with water and fire that never says Enough

verses.original: עַ֤יִן׀ תִּֽלְעַ֣ג לְאָב֮ וְתָב֪וּז לִֽיקֲּהַ֫ת־ אֵ֥ם עֹרְבֵי־ נַ֑חַל יִקְּר֥וּהָ בְנֵי־ נָֽשֶׁר׃פ וְֽיֹאכְל֥וּהָ
verses.transliteration: ‘a·yin til·‘aḡ lə·’āḇ wə·ṯā·ḇūz lîq·qă·haṯ- ’êm ‘ō·rə·ḇê- na·ḥal yiq·qə·rū·hā ḇə·nê- nā·šer wə·yō·ḵə·lū·hā
verses.literal: As for the eye [that] mocks a father and scorns obedience to a mother may the ravens of the valley pluck it out and young vultures devour it

verses.original: הֵ֭מָּה שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה נִפְלְא֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְאַרְבָּע לֹ֣א יְדַעְתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh šə·lō·šāh nip̄·lə·’ū mim·men·nî wə·ʾar·bå̄ʿ lō yə·ḏa‘·tîm
verses.literal: There are three [things] too wonderful for me four that I cannot understand

verses.original: דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַנֶּ֨שֶׁר׀ בַּשָּׁמַיִם֮ דֶּ֥רֶךְ נָחָ֗שׁ עֲלֵ֫י צ֥וּר דֶּֽרֶךְ־ אֳנִיָּ֥ה בְלֶב־ יָ֑ם וְדֶ֖רֶךְ גֶּ֣בֶר בְּעַלְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: de·reḵ han·ne·šer baš·šā·ma·yim de·reḵ nā·ḥāš ‘ă·lê ṣūr de·reḵ- ’o·nî·yāh ḇə·leḇ- yām wə·ḏe·reḵ ge·ḇer bə·‘al·māh
verses.literal: the way of an eagle in the sky the way of a snake on a rock the way of a ship vvv at sea and the way of a man with a maiden

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן׀ דֶּ֥רֶךְ אִשָּׁ֗ה מְנָ֫אָ֥פֶת אָ֭כְלָה וּמָ֣חֲתָה פִ֑יהָ וְ֝אָמְרָ֗ה פָעַ֥לְתִּי לֹֽא־ אָֽוֶן׃פ
verses.transliteration: kên de·reḵ ’iš·šāh mə·nā·’ā·p̄eṯ ’ā·ḵə·lāh ū·mā·ḥă·ṯāh p̄î·hā wə·’ā·mə·rāh p̄ā·‘al·tî lō- ’ā·wen
verses.literal: This is the way of an adulteress . . . She eats and wipes her mouth and says I have done nothing wrong

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת שָׁ֭לוֹשׁ אֶ֑רֶץ רָ֣גְזָה וְתַ֥חַת אַ֝רְבַּ֗ע לֹא־ תוּכַ֥ל שְׂאֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ lō·wōš ’e·reṣ rā·ḡə·zāh wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ ’ar·ba‘ lō- ṯū·ḵal śə·’êṯ
verses.literal: Under three things the earth trembles under four it cannot . . . bear up

verses.original: תַּֽחַת־ עֶ֭בֶד כִּ֣י יִמְל֑וֹךְ וְ֝נָבָ֗ל כִּ֣י יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ- ‘e·ḇeḏ kî yim·lō·wḵ wə·nā·ḇāl kî yiś·ba‘- lā·ḥem
verses.literal: - a servant who becomes king a fool who is filled with food

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת שְׂ֭נוּאָה כִּ֣י תִבָּעֵ֑ל וְ֝שִׁפְחָ֗ה כִּֽי־ תִירַ֥שׁ גְּבִרְתָּֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ śə·nû·ʾāh kî ṯib·bā·‘êl wə·šip̄·ḥāh kî- ṯî·raš gə·ḇir·tāh
verses.literal: - an unloved woman who marries and a maidservant who supplants her mistress

verses.original: אַרְבָּ֣עָה אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝הֵ֗מָּה קְטַנֵּי־ הֵ֭ם מְחֻכָּמִֽים׃ חֲכָמִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: ’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·reṣ wə·hêm·māh qə·ṭan·nê- hêm mə·ḥuk·kā·mîm ḥă·ḵā·mîm
verses.literal: Four things on earth . . . are small yet they are exceedingly wise

verses.original: הַ֭נְּמָלִים עַ֣ם לֹא־ עָ֑ז וַיָּכִ֖ינוּ לַחְמָֽם׃ בַקַּ֣יִץ
verses.transliteration: han·nə·mā·lîm ‘am lō- ‘āz way·yā·ḵî·nū laḥ·mām ḇaq·qa·yiṣ
verses.literal: The ants are creatures of little strength yet they store up their food in the summer

verses.original: שְׁ֭פַנִּים עַ֣ם לֹא־ עָצ֑וּם וַיָּשִׂ֖ימוּ בֵּיתָֽם׃ בַסֶּ֣לַע
verses.transliteration: šə·p̲an·nîm ‘am lō- ‘ā·ṣūm way·yā·śî·mū bê·ṯām ḇas·se·la‘
verses.literal: the rock badgers are creatures of little power yet they make their homes in the rocks

verses.original: לָאַרְבֶּ֑ה אֵ֣ין מֶ֭לֶךְ כֻּלּֽוֹ׃ וַיֵּצֵ֖א חֹצֵ֣ץ
verses.transliteration: lā·’ar·beh ’ên me·leḵ kul·lōw way·yê·ṣê ḥō·ṣêṣ
verses.literal: the locusts have no king yet they all advance in formation

verses.original: שְׂ֭מָמִית תְּתַפֵּ֑שׂ בְּיָדַ֣יִם וְ֝הִ֗יא בְּהֵ֣יכְלֵי מֶֽלֶךְ׃פ
verses.transliteration: śə·mā·mît̲ tə·ṯap·pêś bə·yā·ḏa·yim wə·hî bə·hê·ḵə·lê me·leḵ
verses.literal: and the lizard can be caught in one’s hands yet it [is found] in the palaces of kings

verses.original: הֵ֭מָּה שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה מֵיטִ֣יבֵי צָ֑עַד וְ֝אַרְבָּעָ֗ה מֵיטִ֥בֵי לָֽכֶת׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh šə·lō·šāh mê·ṭî·ḇê ṣā·‘aḏ wə·’ar·bā·‘āh mê·ṭi·ḇê lā·ḵeṯ
verses.literal: There are three things that are stately in their stride and four that are impressive in their walk

verses.original: לַ֭יִשׁ גִּבּ֣וֹר בַּבְּהֵמָ֑ה וְלֹא־ יָ֝שׁ֗וּב מִפְּנֵי־ כֹֽל׃
verses.transliteration: la·yiš gib·bō·wr bab·bə·hê·māh wə·lō- yā·šūḇ mip·pə·nê- ḵōl
verses.literal: a lion mighty among beasts refusing to retreat before anything

verses.original: זַרְזִ֣יר מָתְנַ֣יִם אוֹ־ תָ֑יִשׁ וּ֝מֶ֗לֶךְ אַלְק֥וּם עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: zar·zîr mā·ṯə·na·yim ’ōw- ṯā·yiš ū·me·leḵ ’al·qūm ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: a strutting rooster . . . . . . a he-goat and a king with his army around him

verses.original: אִם־ נָבַ֥לְתָּ בְהִתְנַשֵּׂ֑א וְאִם־ זַ֝מּ֗וֹתָ יָ֣ד לְפֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- nā·ḇal·tā ḇə·hiṯ·naś·śê wə·’im- zam·mō·w·ṯā yāḏ lə·p̄eh
verses.literal: If you have foolishly exalted yourself or if you have plotted evil put your hand over your mouth

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ֪יץ חָלָ֡ב י֘וֹצִ֤יא חֶמְאָ֗ה וּֽמִיץ־ אַ֭ף י֣וֹצִיא דָ֑ם וּמִ֥יץ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם י֣וֹצִיא רִֽיב׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî mîṣ ḥā·lāḇ yō·w·ṣî ḥem·’āh ū·mîṣ- ’ap̄ yō·w·ṣî ḏām ū·mîṣ ’ap·pa·yim yō·w·ṣî rîḇ
verses.literal: For as the churning of milk yields butter and the twisting of the nose draws blood so the stirring of anger brings forth strife
